concerns.text: Task T101 (and all other tasks) are tagged with `[P]` but the specification and plan do not define a `[P]` identifier. This tag is therefore stale and should be removed or replaced with a defined identifier.

Tasks T101‑T114 use tags like `[US1]`, `[US2]`, `[US3]`, `[US4]`, `[US5]`, `[US6]` which are not defined anywhere in the spec (the spec refers to “User Story 1”, etc., without a formal `[US‑N]` tag). These tags are stale and should be aligned with the spec’s naming convention or removed.
